name: 雛菜
text:
なんか最近
雨ばっかり～……
trans: It feels like it's been raining all the time lately~…

name: 小糸
text:
これじゃあ桜も
散っちゃいそうだね……
trans: The cherry blossoms might all fall at this rate...

name: 雛菜
text:
ん～？
それは別にいいけど～
trans: Hm～? I don't really mind it that much though～

name: 雛菜
text:
雨だと学校行くのも濡れちゃって
大変だし
trans:
It's such a hassle to go to school when it rains, 
getting yourself all wet.

name: 雛菜
text:
ちょっとお腹すいた時にも
気軽にコンビニ行けないでしょ～？
trans:
And when you are feeling a bit hungry, you can't just 
dash to the convenience store easily, right?

name: 小糸
trans: Y-Yeah, I guess you are right.

name: 雛菜
text:
だから、はい！
みんな手出して～
trans: Okay, everyone, put out your hands～

name: 雛菜
text:
うん～
じゃんけんで負けた人がね～！
trans: Yep, the person who loses has to go～！

name: 小糸
text:
で、でも
結構雨すごいよ？
trans: B-But.. It's raining really hard you know?

name: 雛菜
text:
だから
じゃんけんするんでしょ～？
trans: That's exactly why we're playing rock-paper-scissors.

name: 雛菜
text: 雛菜行きたくないから勝つ～！
trans: I don't really want to go so I'm gonna win this.

name: 小糸
text: 今行ったらすごい濡れちゃうよ……？
trans: If someone goes now, it will be soaking wet... You know?

name: 円香
trans: So, you won't be playing then?

name: 小糸
text:
あ……
そ、そうじゃなくて……！
trans: Eh... That's not what I meant...!

name: 小糸
text:
お、お腹空いたんだよね？
雛菜ちゃんは

name: 小糸
text:
それなら、この間スーパーで買った
春雨のスープがあるんじゃない……？
trans:
Didn't you bought some harusame noodle soup at the 
supermarket the other day?

name: 小糸
text:
透ちゃんのお家に置いておくって
一緒にお菓子も買ってたよね……？
trans:
When you said you were leaving it at Toru-senpai's 
place, you brought it along with the snacks too, 
right...?

name: 雛菜
trans: Toru-senpai, do we still have those?

name: 雛菜
text:
やは～
じゃあお湯入れてこよ～！
trans:
Yaha～
I'll go pour some hot water then～!

name: 雛菜
trans: Okay, I'll get some for you as well～

name: 小糸
text:
う、うん……！
あ、ありがとう……！

name: 透
text: なんにもしてなくてもさ

name: 透
trans: We aren't doing anything at all.

name: 小糸
text:
わたし、雛菜ちゃん
手伝ってくる
trans: I... I'll go help Hinana-chan with the noodles.
